case.presentation: 84 year old male with 25 pack year smoking history presents with a single 5mm ground-glass nodule.
case.context: CT chest obtained for evaluation of dyspnea. No prior imaging at this institution.

ground_truth.notes: Maintainer assigned high risk: 25-pack-year current smoker. Although below Fleischner's quoted 30-pack-year NLST threshold, current smokers carry 'abundant evidence for cancer risk' per §'Recommendation 1' regardless of pack-year count; the 30py threshold applies to former smokers within 15 years per the paper's NLST framing. Bin is risk-invariant per Table 1B (subsolid <6mm = no routine follow-up regardless of risk).
